path_label: A. Private repository + scheduled workflow
what_it_does: A second repository holds the captures; a scheduled workflow writes immutable hashed artifacts; the public site reads only derived analysis.
cost: one new repository and one workflow
risk: Two repos to keep in sync
evidence_needed: repo created, first artifact hashed and dated
clearing_number: first external artifact with a hash chain that verifies

path_label: B. Object storage bucket
what_it_does: Captures go to versioned object storage with object-lock; the site links to derived views.
cost: storage account and credentials in CI
risk: Cost, and a credential to manage
clearing_number: first object written with a version id and a retention lock

path_label: C. Leave captures in this repository
what_it_does: Status quo: every capture is a committed file in the public repo.
risk: History is mutable; the anti-leakage guarantee is unprovable
clearing_number: not recommended - the owner's own requirement says captures must be outside the static site

path_label: A. No third-party prices; originate only
what_it_does: Publish our fair line and leave the market column blank with the capture attempt logged.
risk: No residual and no CLV can ever be published
clearing_number: a dated, committed policy file

path_label: B. Licensed price vendor
what_it_does: Buy or license a first-party price feed and store it under the same hash discipline.
risk: Licence terms may forbid republication
evidence_needed: a licence whose terms permit storage and derived publication
clearing_number: the licence text committed, plus the first stored price row

path_label: C. Manual single capture per market, per day
what_it_does: Record prices by hand from a screen at a fixed time each day.
risk: Not scalable, not auditable, and easy to get wrong
clearing_number: not recommended - it cannot produce the multi-week, multi-market history the board needs

path_label: A. Per-club official depth pages, verified club by club
what_it_does: Walk all 32 club depth pages, store the raw string, and record which clubs parse and how.
risk: Two clubs are known to break; more may
evidence_needed: 32 dated depth captures with the raw string retained
clearing_number: 32/32 clubs parsed, with the failures named club by club

path_label: B. Derive depth from official snap counts
what_it_does: If an official snap-count source exists, rank by playing time instead.
risk: Requires the source first, and reflects last week, not this week
evidence_needed: one official snap-count read per club-game
clearing_number: one full season of snap counts stored with dates

path_label: C. Stop; leave the deficiency feature unbuilt
what_it_does: Do not build the feature until a route is verified, exactly as the owner ordered.
risk: The feature the owner wants most stays unavailable
clearing_number: this is the default if neither route verifies - it is a legitimate outcome, not a failure

path_label: A. Find an authorized structured source for the Texans
what_it_does: Locate a non-image, authorized depth source for Houston and parse it like any other club.
risk: May not exist
evidence_needed: the source URL and its terms
clearing_number: one parsed, dated Texans depth capture

path_label: B. Exclude Houston from all depth features and say so
what_it_does: Keep the club in the injury register but exclude it from anything that needs a depth order, and publish the exclusion.
risk: Loses one club of coverage
clearing_number: the exclusion row published with its reason

path_label: C. Transcribe the image by eye
what_it_does: Read the depth image and type the values in.
risk: Unverifiable, unauditable, and exactly what R-50 rejects by analogy
clearing_number: not recommended

path_label: A. Current-season pilot, small n
what_it_does: Join this season's designations to whatever inactive lists can be captured now.
risk: n will be small; the interval will be wide
evidence_needed: inactive lists for the current season
clearing_number: a play rate per designation with a confidence interval, n published

path_label: B. Multi-season archive then measure
what_it_does: Wait until S-20 archives several seasons, then measure once with a usable n.
risk: Slow
clearing_number: the same measurement with a materially tighter interval

path_label: C. Leave the designation unusable as a feature
what_it_does: Keep the label on the page and out of the model until it is measured.
risk: Loses a feature the owner explicitly wants
clearing_number: recorded as the safe default; the owner asked for measurement before use

path_label: A. Scheduled workflow writing hashed artifacts
what_it_does: A cron workflow captures on Wed, Thu and Fri and commits a hashed file per capture.
risk: Repository history is not the durable store S-01 asks for
evidence_needed: workflow file plus the first three captures
clearing_number: three dated captures inside one week, each with a fetch timestamp and hash

path_label: B. External scheduler writing to the S-01 store
what_it_does: Same cadence, but the output goes to the external store chosen in S-01.
risk: Depends on S-01
clearing_number: three dated captures in the external store

path_label: C. Keep manual reads
what_it_does: Status quo: a session reads the page when a session happens to run.
risk: The series has gaps exactly when it matters
clearing_number: not recommended - one read per session cannot support a delta

path_label: A. Diff every dimension
what_it_does: Diff designation, practice status, roster status and depth for every player between consecutive snapshots.
risk: Noisy
clearing_number: a rendered diff column with a change count per week

path_label: B. Diff designation changes only
what_it_does: Show only players whose game status or practice status moved.
risk: Misses roster and depth movement
clearing_number: a rendered diff of moved designations only

path_label: A. Move raw rows out; keep derived analysis public
what_it_does: The public site shows indices, ratios and model output; raw rows go private.
risk: Some tables on the site would have to lose their raw rows
evidence_needed: the S-02 decision says this is required
clearing_number: zero row-level official rows in docs/

path_label: B. Keep raw rows but stop publishing official text verbatim
what_it_does: Keep the structure, remove the verbatim official strings.
risk: Half-measure; may not satisfy the terms either way
clearing_number: no verbatim official text in any published table

path_label: C. Keep as is, pending the terms read
what_it_does: Status quo until S-02 answers the question.
risk: The exposure continues while the question is open
clearing_number: acceptable only as a temporary state with a date on it

path_label: A. Freeze all packs as archive, nominate one canonical
what_it_does: Every existing pack stays for provenance; one is nominated canonical and everything new writes there.
risk: The archive still confuses navigation unless S-28 is also decided
clearing_number: one canonical register named in the repo, with the others labelled archive

path_label: B. Auto-merge the packs with conflict resolution
what_it_does: Write a merger that reconciles the column vocabularies and the conflicts.
risk: Silent merges can hide real contradictions
clearing_number: one merged register with every conflict resolved and shown

path_label: A. Register now with a forward window
what_it_does: Write the rule, the window and the gates, commit them, and start from the next week.
risk: None
clearing_number: a commit hash that predates the first kickoff in the window

path_label: B. Register retroactively
what_it_does: Write the rule after seeing some results.
risk: Not registration; the owner rejected this in R-67 by definition
clearing_number: not available - a post-hoc rule cannot predate the window

path_label: A. Brier skill against a fixed 0.5 benchmark
what_it_does: Simple, needs no market data, and is computable today.
risk: A weak benchmark, so skill scores look good
clearing_number: the written choice committed

path_label: B. Brier skill against the market-implied probability
what_it_does: The honest benchmark, but it needs a captured market price.
risk: Unavailable until prices exist
evidence_needed: a captured market price per fixture
clearing_number: the written choice committed plus the first price capture

path_label: C. Log loss
what_it_does: Sharper near the extremes, harsher on confident misses.
risk: Unbounded, so one bad game can dominate
clearing_number: the written choice committed

path_label: A. Keep the gate shut until both halves exist
what_it_does: No parlay or combo may be ranked until a validated joint probability and the operator's void/push rules are both available.
risk: No parlay or combo ever appears on the leaderboard until then
clearing_number: this is the current state and is the recommended default

path_label: B. Allow combos with a documented dependence estimate
what_it_does: Model the dependence and publish the estimate with its uncertainty.
cost: a dependence model and a validation
risk: An unvalidated dependence model is a guess
clearing_number: the joint estimate and its validation both published

path_label: A. Re-read every venue from the official game centre
what_it_does: Open each fixture's game centre page and transcribe the venue field from its text.
risk: Repetitive but bounded
evidence_needed: the game centre URL for each fixture
clearing_number: 13/13 venues with direct on-page provenance

path_label: B. Accept the schedule page's hotel-link provenance
what_it_does: Keep what this session captured and publish the provenance column alongside it.
risk: The venue is an affiliate-link parameter, not a venue field
clearing_number: acceptable only if the owner records that they accept it

path_label: A. Publish the computable half now
what_it_does: Show Out / Doubtful / Questionable counts per club with the replacement column blank.
risk: The view is incomplete by design
evidence_needed: nothing - the counts are already computed
clearing_number: a per-club table with the replacement column visibly blank and flagged

path_label: B. Wait for the depth source
what_it_does: Hold the whole per-team view until replacements can be named.
risk: The owner waits for a view that is half-available today
clearing_number: not recommended - the blank column is informative

path_label: A. Reward proper-score qualification
what_it_does: Pay on qualified skill, never on realised return.
risk: Needs the settled sample from G-SETTLE
evidence_needed: the qualification rule from S-12 and S-13
clearing_number: a reward rule committed before the first competition period

path_label: B. Reward realised ROI
what_it_does: Pay on return.
risk: Rewards variance, and the owner already rejected ROI ranking in R-65
clearing_number: not available - inconsistent with R-65 and R-38

path_label: A. Two controls on every run, shown by default
what_it_does: Random-pick and favourites-only controls scored on the same sample and rendered beside every strategy row.
risk: None
clearing_number: both control rows visible on every leaderboard render

path_label: B. Controls in a separate panel
what_it_does: Keep the leaderboard clean and put the controls in their own comparison panel.
risk: The comparison is easier to ignore
clearing_number: a control panel that renders with every leaderboard run

path_label: A. Fixed minimum n plus a Bonferroni-style adjustment
what_it_does: Simple, conservative and easy to audit.
risk: Conservative enough to reject real skill on short samples
clearing_number: the rule written and committed before the first ranking

path_label: B. Fixed minimum n plus a false-discovery-rate control
what_it_does: Less conservative, still controls the multiple-comparison problem.
risk: Slightly harder to explain to a reviewer
clearing_number: the rule written and committed before the first ranking

path_label: A. Threshold on the proper score's lower bound
what_it_does: Demote when the game-cluster lower bound of the proper score falls below the control.
risk: Slow to fire, which is the point
evidence_needed: a settled sample and the control baseline
clearing_number: a written threshold plus at least one recorded firing or a recorded clean run

path_label: B. Threshold on drawdown as well
what_it_does: Demote on either a skill breach or a drawdown breach.
risk: Drawdown is a staking quantity; the owner separated signal from staking in R-05
clearing_number: not recommended - it re-couples signal and staking, which R-05 forbids

path_label: A. Show the control-only panel with the sample size that would fill it
what_it_does: Honest about being empty and tells the reader exactly what is missing.
risk: None
clearing_number: a panel that renders with the required n printed on it

path_label: B. Hide the panel until a settled sample exists
what_it_does: Do not show an empty panel at all.
risk: The reader loses the reminder that luck has not been removed yet
clearing_number: acceptable; the decision is cosmetic

path_label: A. Capture the league's roof designation and pair it with NWS grids
what_it_does: The full feature as the owner specified it.
cost: a capture per fixture plus a weather fetch
risk: Two sources to keep in sync
evidence_needed: the official roof source and api.weather.gov
clearing_number: one week of fixtures with both halves stored and dated

path_label: A2. Weather only, and treat roof as unknown
what_it_does: Publish the NWS half and leave the roof blank rather than inferring it.
risk: Totals remain mispriced for dome games
clearing_number: one week of NWS forecasts stored, with the roof column blank and flagged

path_label: A. Quote the official rule text before setting any prior
what_it_does: Read the rule, quote it with a URL, and derive the prior from the quotation.
risk: None
clearing_number: the rule text quoted with its source URL in the repo

path_label: B. Leave the prior blank until the rule is read
what_it_does: No prior at all, which is the honest default.
risk: Game totals carry an unmodelled regime effect
clearing_number: acceptable; this is the current state

path_label: A. Retention job now, backfill later
what_it_does: Start archiving this week's reports immediately and treat backfill as a separate problem.
risk: The measurement waits for the archive to grow
clearing_number: the first four consecutive weekly archives with hashes

path_label: B. Look for a backfill source first
what_it_does: Try to recover prior seasons before investing in retention.
risk: Past weeks may simply not exist anywhere accessible
evidence_needed: a source offering historical weekly reports
clearing_number: >=1 prior season recovered, or a recorded negative result

path_label: A. Freeze the two specifications now, run later
what_it_does: Write down the with-features and without-features models, the holdout windows and the uncertainty method; run it when the depth source clears.
risk: None
clearing_number: a committed design file whose commit predates any run

path_label: B. Wait and design after the data exists
what_it_does: Design the ablation once the features are actually available.
risk: The design would then be written with the data in view, which is result-chasing
clearing_number: not recommended - it breaks the pre-registration discipline the owner asked for

path_label: A. Three disjoint season windows committed now
what_it_does: Fix train, validation and final holdout by season and commit the split.
risk: None
clearing_number: the split committed before the first fit

path_label: B. Split chronologically within a season
what_it_does: Use in-season chronological folds instead of whole seasons.
risk: Leakage risk across folds within a season
clearing_number: acceptable but weaker; the owner asked for seasons

path_label: A. Enforce the row-count and required-field pins repo-wide in CI
what_it_does: Every pack's verifier fails the build when a pinned count or a required field is missing.
risk: Some existing packs would start failing
evidence_needed: a per-source expected row count and required-field list
clearing_number: every pack's CI running the pin check

path_label: B. Enforce it in new packs only
what_it_does: New packs ship with pins; existing packs are left alone.
risk: The existing packs keep publishing silently-empty columns
clearing_number: a compromise; the reviewer should decide

path_label: A. Restrict to fields the schedule page prints
what_it_does: Date, kickoff time, network, venue and published records only; nothing derived.
risk: A thin feature set
clearing_number: a written feature list with the page field named beside each item

path_label: B. Add derived rest and travel from those fields
what_it_does: Compute rest days and travel from the published dates and venues.
cost: a derivation with the method shown
risk: Derived facts can be wrong in ways the page will not reveal
evidence_needed: the derivation written down and checked against the page
clearing_number: each derived feature with its derivation published

path_label: A. Two named estimators with a walk-forward collapse rule
what_it_does: Name both estimators, publish the gap column, and collapse only on a written walk-forward result.
risk: None
clearing_number: two estimators running, and a collapse rule expressed as a number

path_label: B. Keep one estimator and drop the duplication
what_it_does: Skip the two-estimator rule.
risk: Breaks R-62, and removes the only guard against picking the wrong estimator
clearing_number: not recommended - the owner asked for both

path_label: A. Render as 'not listed (bye)' with the source link
what_it_does: State the reason in the cell, never a zero.
risk: None
clearing_number: every absent club rendered with the reason and the source link

path_label: B. Omit absent clubs from the table entirely
what_it_does: Show only clubs the page actually lists.
risk: Hides the fact that four clubs were not covered, which is decision-relevant
clearing_number: not recommended - omission reads as zero

path_label: A. Merge the duplicates and keep a pointer row
what_it_does: Merge R-27 into R-28 and R-67 into R-69, keeping the dropped id as a pointer.
risk: None
clearing_number: the merged register with pointer rows

path_label: B. Keep them separate as deliberate duplicates
what_it_does: Leave the register exactly as the owner wrote it.
risk: The register stays longer than it needs to be
clearing_number: acceptable; this is the current state

path_label: A. Canonical pack plus an archive section
what_it_does: One pack on the main nav; the rest behind a single archive link.
risk: Some sessions' work becomes harder to find
clearing_number: hub navigation with one canonical NFL pack and one archive link

path_label: B. Keep every pack on the hub
what_it_does: Status quo.
risk: The hub keeps growing and the decision path gets longer
clearing_number: not recommended alongside S-09 option A, which needs the same decision
